topic: Animal Body Parts, Activities, and Importance to Humans
key_concepts: Animals can be grouped by how they move: crawling, walking, swimming, jumping, and flying.
Animals use body parts such as feet, wings, fins, and body to move.
Animals use different body parts to get food, including mouth, feet, beak, and tongue.
Animals can be grouped by the kind of food they eat, such as plants, meat/fish, grains, ri
Animals have different body coverings: feathers, hair, scales, and shell.
Animals live in different habitats: land, freshwater, saltwater, air, and both land and wa
Some animals provide food to people.
Some animals help people by providing materials for clothing, decorations, and income.
A dog walks using its feet; a snail crawls using its body.
A chicken uses its beak and feet to get food; a frog uses its tongue to catch insects.
Fish have scales, turtles have shells, and carabao skin can be made into leather.
